articles.summary: SAN DIEGO [June 12, 2023] – Trestle Biotherapeutics today received a $1 million prize from the KidneyX Innovation Accelerator through the organization’s Artificial Kidney Prize program. Trestle is one of eight Artificial Kidney Prize Phase 2 winners announced today. The post Trestle Biotherapeutics Wins Prestigious KidneyX Prize first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .
articles.title: Trestle Biotherapeutics Wins Prestigious KidneyX Prize
